# FIFO Queue Request & Response Handling Specification

## Request Specification

### Create Reservation Request

```typescript
interface CreateReservationRequest {
  // HTTP Headers
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    'Idempotency-Key': string // UUIDv4 generated by client
    'X-Request-ID'?: string // Optional client request ID for tracing
  }

  // Request Body
  body: {
    clientBasket: ClientBasket
  }
}

interface ClientBasket {
  products: ClientBasketProduct[]
  totalAmount: number
  currency: string
}

interface ClientBasketProduct {
  id: string
  stripePriceId: string
  quantity: number
}

// Expected Response
interface CreateReservationResponse {
  success: boolean
  data?: {
    reservationToken: string
    reservedBasket: ReservedBasket
    expiresAt: string // ISO timestamp
  }
  error?: {
    code: string
    message: string
    details?: any
  }
  requestId: string
  status: 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed'
}
```

### Realize Reservation Request (Payment Webhook)

```typescript
interface RealizeReservationRequest {
  // HTTP Headers (from Stripe webhook)
  headers: {
    'stripe-signature': string
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }

  // Request Body (Stripe webhook payload)
  body: {
    type: string // e.g., 'checkout.session.completed'
    data: {
      object: {
        id: string
        metadata: {
          reservation_token: string
        }
        payment_status: string
        amount_total: number
      }
    }
  }
}

// Expected Response
interface RealizeReservationResponse {
  success: boolean
  data?: {
    message: string
    reservationRealized: boolean
    orderConfirmation?: {
      orderId: string
      itemsSold: ProductSold[]
    }
  }
  error?: {
    code: string
    message: string
    details?: any
  }
  requestId: string
  status: 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed'
}
```

## Response Handling Specification

### Response Status Codes

```typescript
// HTTP Status Code Mapping
const RESPONSE_STATUS_MAP = {
  // Success responses
  200: 'completed', // Request completed successfully
  202: 'processing', // Request accepted, processing in queue

  // Client error responses
  400: 'failed', // Bad request
  401: 'failed', // Unauthorized (webhook signature invalid)
  409: 'failed', // Conflict (operation in progress)
  422: 'failed', // Validation error
  429: 'failed', // Rate limited

  // Server error responses
  500: 'failed', // Internal server error
  503: 'failed', // Service unavailable (circuit breaker open)
}
```

### Error Response Structure

```typescript
interface ErrorResponse {
  success: false
  error: {
    code: ErrorCode
    message: string
    details?: {
      field?: string
      value?: any
      constraint?: string
    }
    retryable?: boolean
    retryAfter?: number // milliseconds
  }
  requestId: string
  status: 'failed'
}

type ErrorCode =
  // Client errors
  | 'INVALID_REQUEST_FORMAT'
  | 'MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY'
  | 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH'
  | 'RESERVATION_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND'
  | 'OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS'
  | 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK'
  | 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND'
  | 'INVALID_STRIPE_PRICE'

  // Server errors
  | 'DATABASE_ERROR'
  | 'QUEUE_PROCESSING_ERROR'
  | 'STOCK_UPDATE_ERROR'
  | 'SERVICE_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE'
  | 'TIMEOUT_ERROR'
```

## Request Processing Flow

```typescript
class RequestProcessor {
  async processRequest(request: QueueRequest): Promise<QueueResponse> {
    try {
      // 1. Validate request format
      this.validateRequestFormat(request)

      // 2. Check idempotency
      const cachedResponse = await this.checkIdempotency(request)
      if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse
      }

      // 3. Execute business logic
      const result = await this.executeBusinessLogic(request)

      // 4. Store response for idempotency
      await this.storeResponse(request.idempotencyKey, result)

      return {
        requestId: request.id,
        status: 'completed',
        data: result
      }

    } catch (error) {
      return this.handleError(request, error)
    }
  }

  private validateRequestFormat(request: QueueRequest): void {
    const schema = this.getValidationSchema(request.type)
    const validationResult = schema.validate(request.payload)

    if (!validationResult.valid) {
      throw new ValidationError('INVALID_REQUEST_FORMAT', validationResult.errors)
    }
  }

  private async checkIdempotency(request: QueueRequest): Promise<QueueResponse | null> {
    const cached = await this.idempotencyStore.get(request.idempotencyKey)

    if (!cached) {
      return null
    }

    // Validate request fingerprint
    const currentFingerprint = this.generateFingerprint(request)
    if (cached.requestFingerprint !== currentFingerprint) {
      throw new ValidationError('IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH')
    }

    return cached.response
  }

  private async executeBusinessLogic(request: QueueRequest): Promise<any> {
    switch (request.type) {
      case 'create_reservation':
        return await this.handleCreateReservation(request)
      case 'rollback_reservation':
        return await this.handleRollbackReservation(request)
      case 'realize_reservation':
        return await this.handleRealizeReservation(request)
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown request type: ${request.type}`)
    }
  }

  private handleError(request: QueueRequest, error: Error): QueueResponse {
    const errorResponse = this.mapErrorToResponse(error)

    // Log error for monitoring
    this.logError(request, error)

    return {
      requestId: request.id,
      status: 'failed',
      error: errorResponse
    }
  }
}
```

## Response Generation

```typescript
class ResponseGenerator {
  generateSuccessResponse(
    requestId: string,
    data: any,
    status: 'processing' | 'completed' = 'completed'
  ): QueueResponse {
    return {
      requestId,
      status,
      success: true,
      data,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }

  generateErrorResponse(
    requestId: string,
    error: Error,
    httpStatus: number
  ): QueueResponse {
    const errorCode = this.mapErrorToCode(error)
    const isRetryable = this.isRetryableError(error)

    return {
      requestId,
      status: 'failed',
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: errorCode,
        message: error.message,
        retryable: isRetryable,
        retryAfter: isRetryable ? this.calculateRetryDelay(error) : undefined
      },
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }

  private mapErrorToCode(error: Error): ErrorCode {
    const errorMapping: Record<string, ErrorCode> = {
      'ValidationError': 'INVALID_REQUEST_FORMAT',
      'IdempotencyMismatchError': 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH',
      'OperationInProgressError': 'OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS',
      'InsufficientStockError': 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK',
      'ProductNotFoundError': 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND',
      'DatabaseError': 'DATABASE_ERROR',
      'CircuitBreakerOpenError': 'SERVICE_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE'
    }

    return errorMapping[error.constructor.name] || 'DATABASE_ERROR'
  }

  private isRetryableError(error: Error): boolean {
    const retryableErrors = [
      'DatabaseError',
      'TimeoutError',
      'NetworkError'
    ]

    return retryableErrors.includes(error.constructor.name)
  }
}
```

## HTTP Response Formatting

```typescript
// Express.js middleware for response formatting
function queueResponseHandler(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  const originalSend = res.send

  res.send = function(data: QueueResponse) {
    // Set appropriate HTTP status
    const httpStatus = mapStatusToHttp(data.status)
    res.status(httpStatus)

    // Set standard headers
    res.set({
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-Request-ID': data.requestId,
      'X-Response-Time': Date.now().toString()
    })

    // Handle processing status
    if (data.status === 'processing') {
      res.set('X-Processing', 'true')
      res.set('X-Estimated-Wait', '30000') // 30 seconds
    }

    // Send formatted response
    return originalSend.call(this, JSON.stringify(data))
  }

  next()
}

function mapStatusToHttp(status: QueueResponse['status']): number {
  switch (status) {
    case 'completed': return 200
    case 'processing': return 202
    case 'failed': return 500
    default: return 500
  }
}
```

## Request Validation Schemas

```typescript
// Joi validation schemas
const createReservationSchema = Joi.object({
  clientBasket: Joi.object({
    products: Joi.array().items(
      Joi.object({
        id: Joi.string().required(),
        stripePriceId: Joi.string().required(),
        quantity: Joi.number().integer().min(1).required()
      })
    ).required(),
    totalAmount: Joi.number().positive().required(),
    currency: Joi.string().valid('PLN').required()
  }).required()
})

const rollbackReservationSchema = Joi.object({
  reservationToken: Joi.string().uuid().required()
})

const realizeReservationSchema = Joi.object({
  type: Joi.string().valid('checkout.session.completed').required(),
  data: Joi.object({
    object: Joi.object({
      id: Joi.string().required(),
      metadata: Joi.object({
        reservation_token: Joi.string().uuid().required()
      }).required(),
      payment_status: Joi.string().valid('paid').required(),
      amount_total: Joi.number().positive().required()
    }).required()
  }).required()
})
```
